fault: Two Common_Packages declare a dependency on each other, forming a cycle the repository-wide build's Verification_Pass detects while ordering statement 3 over every Common_Package.

partition.justification: An npm clean install over this workspace succeeds — npm installs mutually dependent workspace packages without objection — while the ordered repository build's Build_Sequence Verification_Pass still reports the Common_Package cycle over the installed tree. No microservice and no Entry_Package depends on either package, so the dependency resolver never reaches the cycle and [deps:cycle] does not fire; the cycle surfaces only when statement 3 orders every Common_Package.
